name: wfh_laundry_lift_groceries
prompt: Plan my work-from-home day from 08:00 to 21:00. I work 09:00-17:00. I have standup 10:00-10:30, planning 13:00-13:30, and a client call 15:30-16:00. Wash clothes for 30 minutes starting at 08:00, transfer them for 5 minutes within 15 minutes after washing, then dry them for 45 minutes immediately after the transfer. Lift for 60 minutes and get groceries for 45 minutes; both are required, and groceries must finish by 20:30. I would like lifting finished by 16:00, priority 5, and prefer to minimize work interruptions, priority 3.

name: multiple_meetings
prompt: My day runs 08:00-18:00 and my work hours are 09:00-17:00. Put in a team sync from 09:30 to 10:00 and a client meeting from 14:00 to 15:00. I also need a 30-minute active email block and a 60-minute active report block.

name: clarified_monday_wfh_full_problem
prompt: On Mondays, I work from home. Our general hours are from 9am to 6pm. My Mondays are pretty light, so I have time to do errands during the day. I usually have a single meeting from 10:30am to 11:00am. I need to do groceries which takes 30 minutes. Laundry is across the street: wash takes 30 minutes, transferring takes 5 minutes, and drying takes 45 minutes. I can work while the machines are running but need to be free for the transfer. I also need to lift which takes an hour. I prefer to lift in the early afternoon as there are less people there. It gets crowded around 4pm. Grocery shopping also gets crowded in the afternoon so I prefer to go before lunch. I like to eat lunch around 12pm to 1pm if I can. How should I plan my day?
clarification: Yes those stated work hours should bound the whole plan. Lunch should take 30 minutes.

name: active_and_passive
prompt: Schedule 09:00-12:00. There is a meeting from 09:00-10:00. Start the dishwasher at 09:00; it runs passively for 90 minutes. I need a 30-minute active phone call after 10:30.

name: laundry_precedence
prompt: Use an 08:00-14:00 horizon. Laundry has three required steps: wash is passive for 30 minutes, transfer is active for 5 minutes, and dry is passive for 45 minutes. Transfer must happen after washing and within 10 minutes of its finish; drying starts immediately after transfer.

name: hard_timing
prompt: The available day is 08:00-18:00. I must do a required 45-minute active workout no earlier than 16:00 and it must finish no later than 18:00. I also need a required 20-minute active shower after the workout.

name: soft_finish_preference
prompt: Plan a 09:00-17:00 day with a required 60-minute active report. I would ideally like the report finished by 15:00, but that is only a preference.

name: work_interruption_preference
prompt: My day is 08:00-18:00 and my work window is 09:00-17:00. I need a required 45-minute active workout and a required 30-minute active grocery trip. Prefer to keep work interruptions to a minimum.

name: no_work_window
prompt: Schedule my day from 10:00 to 16:00. I have a fixed dentist appointment from 12:00 to 13:00 and need a 30-minute active errand. I did not specify work hours because this is not a work day.

name: paraphrase_variation
prompt: Keep 07:00-20:00 open. I have to attend a stand-up from 09:00 until 09:15. A 20 min hands-on breakfast task and a 40 minute machine cycle are needed; the machine cycle can run unattended. The breakfast task cannot overlap the stand-up.

name: ambiguous_missing_horizon
prompt: I need to get laundry and groceries done today. Laundry takes some time and groceries should be convenient. Please make a plan.

name: ambiguous_missing_durations
prompt: Schedule my workout before my appointment sometime tomorrow afternoon. The appointment is fixed, and I would like the workout earlier if possible.

name: deadline_paraphrase
prompt: For a 09:00-19:00 day, I need a required active 90-minute study session done by 17:00. A required passive 30-minute oven timer may run unattended. I must attend a class from 18:00-19:00.
